title: One Adapter, One Lineage: prove train-to-browser mechanics end to end

deploy.note: Production proof will be recorded only after exact-main Fast verification and Pages deployment succeed.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: Local proof passed: 4,491 tests with 162 skips, the 34-course layered evaluation, formatting, lint, release-history, exact-lineage, 400/92 review-ledger reproducibility, build, bundle budgets, and the Chromium changelog proof. Exact-main CI and production deployment remain pending.

claims.summary: Device receipts and run IDs derive v0.16.39 from the exact adapter manifest and no longer reuse the historical v0.16.25 label.
The exact v0.16.31 seeded MLX source is bound through pinned conversion to one 52,704,096-byte GGUF and its complete small-file provenance chain.

One real Chrome 150 Apple-Silicon run proves exact public-base recovery, native activation, changed output, exact rollback, storage and GPU-process recovery, repeated completion, measured memory, and no unexpected console failures for the same adapter lineage.
The audit verifies every retained plan, result, source, conversion, trace, runtime, hardware, and console receipt while requiring both base and adapter weights to remain outside Git.

The neutral ledger deterministically rebuilds to 400 cases across sixteen groups but only 92 source-grounded cases; the stale 128-case workbook must not be scored, the corpus remains smoke-only at 76/418 usable rows and zero same-identity Codex preferences, and the exact adapter is non-promotable.
